title: Dietary Phytoestrogens and Bone Metabolism
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether dietary phytoestrogens are an effective alternative to postmenopausal exogenous estrogen replacement therapy in preventing bone loss.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Postmenopausal
* Weight within 90% to 120% of ideal body weight
* 12 or more months since last menstrual period
* New York Metro Area resident

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of cancer, diabetes, or heart disease
* Smoker
